To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a real-time CIF decoder for H.264 video can be built on a 16 MHz SoC platform, and that the decoder can be integrated with an ARM9 CPU and a video accelerator.

(1) a highly integrated H.264/ AVC main profile video decoder can be realized on a single SoC platform; (2) the decoder can be designed to be very low power, consuming 8mW; (3) it can be implemented with a very low operating frequency, 16MHz; (4) it can be integrated into a multimedia SoCs with other IPs, such as video encoder and audio codec; and (5) it is very easy to use and
we present a real-time H.264/ACV main profile video decoder prototype that achieves 8mW of power consumption and is integrated into a 16MHz multimedia SoC platform.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a complete solution for the H.264/ACV main profile decoder.
the design of low-power, high-performance H.264/ AVC video decoder IP core and its system level integration.

the following issues: (i) how to design a high performance hardwired H.264/ AVC decoder core; (ii) how to integrate the decoder core into a multimedia SoCs platform; (iii) how to reduce the memory traffic and system cost.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed decoder is the first hardwired design that is capable of real-time decoding CIF video at a low operating frequency.
our design is able to decode CIF video at 30fps, with a power consumption of 8mW.
our design is the first real-time decoder for the main profile of H.264/ACV standard on a 16Mhz system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we achieve 8mW power consumption, which is 1.5 times less than the previous best design.
the decoder is highly integrated and very efficient.
we have developed an 8mW CIF decoder running at 16MHz.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a highly optimized H.264 decoder can be designed to fit into the limited resources available in a low-cost, low-power SoC platform, and can be integrated into the platform to achieve real-time performance.
the proposed architecture can be scaled to support higher resolution video and can be implemented in low cost SoC platform.
it is feasible to implement a real-time decoder on a single-chip SoC platform.
